title: Following a scalar Kalman update
description: You can track a mean estimate and variance across five observations.

steps.description: You initialize the estimate xhat and variance P, along with model and noise parameters. zs supplies five observations.
The prediction carries xhat through A and adds Q to the propagated variance. The control term contributes zero in this example.

steps.question: Which difference does the gain K scale in the estimate update?
steps.answer: It scales z minus H times xhat, the observed value minus the predicted observation.

steps.description: You update both xhat and P for every z. The supplied output ends at xhat 0.982 and P 0.059, with the printed variance decreasing across these updates.
